attempts.diagnostic: No Docker-compatible runtime, passwordless sudo, or usable rootless namespace support.
attempts.resolution: Coordinator reassigned this arm to an isolated local control-plane target.

attempts.diagnostic: Official installer SSE terminated after the exact stack was already healthy; Colima did not mirror /private/tmp bind outputs.
attempts.resolution: Readiness-gated recovery copied generated Compose files from the exact installer container.

attempts.diagnostic: Colima runtime could not reach a macOS-hosted sink, and the generated execution key did not authorize the TablesDB write at the external API endpoint.
attempts.resolution: Placed an arm-owned sink on the isolated runtimes network and configured the arm API key as a secret function variable.

attempts.diagnostic: Concurrent and array multi-channel subscribe patterns failed to observe later wall/guest channels; collection delivery also required table-level read authority.
attempts.resolution: Awaited subscriptions sequentially and modeled visibility/revocation with explicit table permission transitions.

attempts.diagnostic: Cron scheduler loaded and enqueued the function, but the execution was not inspectable inside the bounded harness wait.
attempts.resolution: Used Appwrite's native future scheduledAt execution API with minute precision.

attempts.diagnostic: A fresh browser raced anonymous Realtime registration with Auth restoration; repeated client-session burst writes also reached endpoint rate limiting.
attempts.resolution: Subscribed only after Auth and used native server batch createRows for each exact 20-row burst.

attempts.diagnostic: Compose cleanup left three exact project-named Open Runtimes containers, while docker inspect of the absent sink returned an empty JSON array on stdout despite failure.
attempts.resolution: Validated runtime name/ID/type/image before removal, changed the sink probe to use exit status, and added an Open Runtimes negative probe.
